$comment: Spark AI model catalogue (v2). This file is the SERVER-SIDE ALLOWLIST as well as the
source for the model picker — a model id arriving from the client is only ever accepted
if it appears in `models[]`, and an effort only if it appears in that model's `efforts[]`.
Schema is model-first, not provider-first: the user picks a model, and `servedBy` maps it
to the id each provider uses for it (they differ — the gateway says `xai/grok-4.5` where
OpenRouter says `x-ai/grok-4.5`). Resolution walks `providers` by `priority`, keeps those
whose `envKey` is set AND which appear in the model's `servedBy`, and takes the first.
`efforts` uses the AI SDK's provider-agnostic reasoning scale, passed to streamText as
`reasoning`. The SDK normalises it to each provider's native parameter, so there is no
per-vendor mapping here. A model with an empty `efforts` array does not support reasoning
control and its picker row has no submenu.
Ids were verified against the live Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter model listings.
When adding a model, check both listings rather than guessing the slug.
